body:
## Why

`scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:18-26` (`ensure_destination`) calls `shutil.rmtree(destination)` whenever the destination exists and `force=True`. Nothing resolves the path, rejects a symlink, or requires it to sit under the disposable `.consumer-tests/` root that `DEFAULT_DESTINATION` (`scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:15`) points at. `main()` calls it at `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:92` before rendering.

The two flags invite the destructive combination: the `--destination` help at `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:52-57` reads "Directory for the rendered integration repo or existing repo path", and the `--force` help at `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:63-67` reads "Remove existing destination contents before rendering" — it removes the directory tree itself. `docs/setup_integration_tests.md:14` and `docs/pr_body.md:9` both recommend `--force` as the default invocation.

Verified at tip `e4b6adecb7cee6750b37d697d2c487153678e0a2` (2026-09-13): `parse_args(['--destination', '<an existing home directory>', '--force'])` yields that directory unchanged as `args.destination`, and `ensure_destination` would pass it straight to `shutil.rmtree`. The existing test `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py:19-27` (`test_ensure_destination_force_clears`) exercises the deletion on a `tmp_path` directory that is not under `.consumer-tests/`, so the test suite currently asserts the unsafe behaviour.

Latent, not a current CI break: `git grep run_consumer_repo_tests` finds no workflow invoking the script (docs only), so exposure is an operator or autonomous agent running the documented command with a wrong `--destination`. Lowered from the audit's BLOCKER to P2 for that reason; the cost when it fires is an entire checkout or home directory.

## Scope

- `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py` — `ensure_destination`, `parse_args`, `main`.
- `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py` — containment tests; adjust the existing force test.
- `docs/setup_integration_tests.md` — state the containment rule next to the `--force` example.

## Implementation Notes

- Introduce `DEFAULT_DISPOSABLE_ROOT = Path(".consumer-tests")` next to `DEFAULT_DESTINATION` in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py` and give `ensure_destination` a keyword parameter `disposable_root: Path = DEFAULT_DISPOSABLE_ROOT`.
- Resolve both paths with `Path.resolve()`; run `shutil.rmtree` only when `resolved_root in resolved_destination.parents` (strict descendant — equality with the root is refused). Refuse when `destination.is_symlink()` before resolving, so a symlink inside `.consumer-tests/` cannot redirect the deletion outside it.
- Raise a dedicated exception (for example a `FileExistsError` subclass or `ValueError`) whose message names both the offending path and `.consumer-tests`; extend the `except` at `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:94` so `main()` returns 1 with that message on stderr.
- Keep `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py::test_ensure_destination_force_clears` valid by passing `disposable_root=tmp_path`.
- `--skip-render` (`scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py:87-90`) never deletes and needs no change.
- `scripts/runner_lib/core.py:206-231` already implements the same contained-child pattern for `.reference`; mirror its shape rather than inventing a new one.

## Tasks

- [ ] Add a `disposable_root` parameter and a resolved strict-descendant check to `ensure_destination` in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py` so `shutil.rmtree` runs only for a directory under `.consumer-tests/`.
- [ ] Refuse a symlinked destination and a destination equal to the disposable root in `ensure_destination` in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py`, and make `main()` in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py` return 1 with the offending path in the stderr message.
- [ ] Rewrite the `--force` and `--destination` help strings in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py` to say that `--force` deletes the destination directory tree and is honoured only under `.consumer-tests/`.
- [ ] Add `test_ensure_destination_force_rejects_outside_disposable_root` and `test_ensure_destination_force_rejects_symlink_destination` to `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py`, and pass `disposable_root=tmp_path` in the existing `test_ensure_destination_force_clears`.
- [ ] Add `test_main_force_outside_disposable_root_returns_1` to `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py` asserting the CLI path exits 1 and leaves the directory contents in place.
- [ ] Update the `--force` example in `docs/setup_integration_tests.md` to state the `.consumer-tests/` containment rule.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `pytest tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py` passes, including `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py::test_ensure_destination_force_rejects_outside_disposable_root`, which calls `ensure_destination(outside_dir, force=True, disposable_root=root_dir)` on a non-empty directory outside `root_dir`, asserts an exception is raised, and asserts the directory and its file still exist afterwards.
- `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py::test_main_force_outside_disposable_root_returns_1` asserts `main(["--destination", str(outside_dir), "--force"])` returns 1, that stderr names the path and `.consumer-tests`, and that `outside_dir` still contains its file.
- `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py::test_ensure_destination_force_clears` still passes with `disposable_root=tmp_path`, so the intended deletion inside the disposable root keeps working.
- Deliberate break: temporarily remove the strict-descendant check from `ensure_destination` in `scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py`, confirm `tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py::test_ensure_destination_force_rejects_outside_disposable_root` fails, then revert.
- `ruff check scripts/run_consumer_repo_tests.py tests/scripts/test_run_consumer_repo_tests.py` reports zero findings.

## Non-Goals

- No change to `tools/integration_repo.py` rendering behaviour.
- No general-purpose safe-delete helper shared across the repository; `scripts/runner_lib/core.py` keeps its own contained deletion.
- No change to `--skip-render` semantics.
- Scaffold-only completion does NOT count: adding the `disposable_root` parameter without the resolved strict-descendant check on the code path before `shutil.rmtree`, or adding the new tests without the assertion that the outside directory and its file survive, is a failure of this issue.
title: [P2] run_consumer_repo_tests --force deletes any --destination directory with no containment check
